L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Every forward frame shall consist of 1 start + 1 address byte (YAAAAAAB MSB-first) + 1 data byte (MSB-first) + 2 stop.
L16: Every backward frame shall consist of 1 start + 1 data byte + 2 stop.
L16: All bits shall be Manchester-encoded at 1200 baud (TE = 416.67 μs).
L16: Logic '1' = LOW→HIGH mid-bit; logic '0' = HIGH→LOW mid-bit.
L16: The bus shall be polarity-insensitive at receivers.
L16: Bus voltage shall be 9.5..22.5 V DC (IEC); 11.5..22.5 V per TI report.
L16: Bus current shall not exceed 250 mA.
L16: Direct arc-power level shall follow the 254-level logarithmic dimming curve; 0=OFF; 255=MASK.
L16: Minimum Level shall be ≥ PHYS_MIN_LEVEL.
L16: Maximum Level shall be ≤ 254.
L16: Backward frame shall start between 7×TE and 22×TE after end of forward.
L16: Next forward frame shall not start sooner than 22×TE; 13.5 ms IEC-recommended.
L16: Destructive commands shall be sent twice within 100 ms to commit.
L16: Address byte Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 shall be Broadcast.
L16: Special-command address bytes 0xA1..0xCF identify a Special Command per Table 5.
L16: Persistent variables shall survive bus power cycle.
L16: Upon power-up apply Power On Level within 600 ms if no command.
L16: Upon bus voltage loss apply System Failure Level.
L16: Configuration Mode shall auto-exit at 15 minutes if no TERMINATE.
L16: RANDOMIZE shall regenerate Random Address.
L16: COMPARE shall return 0xFF when Random ≤ Search.
L16: WITHDRAW shall remove gear when Random == Search.
L16: QUERY STATUS shall return 8-bit status byte.
